Indian Airlines Suspend Saudi Flights Amid Security Concerns

Several Indian airlines, including Air India, Air India Express, Akasa Air, and IndiGo, have suspended flights to Saudi Arabian cities. The suspension is in effect until at least October 20, with Akasa Air and IndiGo extending their suspension until October 24. This action comes amid security concerns, prompting India to remind its nationals in Saudi Arabia to stay indoors in case of an aerial attack.
